cohort: Admissions with stillbirths at or beyond 24 weeks or neonatal deaths within 28 days of birth at a district hospital in eastern Uganda in 2014
finding: The rate of perinatal death at the rural Ugandan hospital was higher than national targets, and these deaths were associated with prematurity, low birth weight, breech presentation, multiple gestation, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased odds of perinatal death.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with perinatal death
